title: Boolean cube and sign cube equivalence
statement: For each natural number $n$, the set of Boolean vectors of length $n$ is equivalent to the set of sign vectors of length $n$, by applying the Boolean-to-sign correspondence coordinate by coordinate.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the coordinatewise Boolean-to-sign correspondence.
